events.headline: Astra usage reset fully propagated
events.summary: Tibo confirmed the Astra usage reset has fully propagated: "Reset all propagated. Sweet dreams." This follows the earlier announcement of a reset landing by midnight.

events.headline: Astra usage reset landing by midnight today
events.summary: Tibo announced a reset for Astra users, landing by midnight today, alongside quality fixes for skills, context management, and engines.

events.headline: Banked resets re-issued after a morning apply failure
events.summary: Tibo said some banked resets did not fully apply this morning on ChatGPT Work and Codex. Affected users are getting another banked reset and an apology email.
